name: 2-oxo-3-hydroxy-lysergide
summary: 2-Oxo-3-hydroxy-LSD, or 2-oxy-3-hydroxy-LSD, also known as O-H-LSD or OH-LSD, as well as more fully as 2-oxo-3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydro-LSD, is a lysergamide and the major metabolite of the psychedelic drug lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). LSD is eliminated 13% as O-H-LSD in urine within 24 hours and urinary concentrations of O-H-LSD are 4 to 40 times those of LSD in humans.

pharmacology.text: It is unknown whether O-H-LSD is pharmacologically active or produces hallucinogenic effects.

uses.text: It started being sold online as an analytical standard by 2024.
